_doc: Generic words that may appear in the skill although some testbed config uses them as a value. Each entry needs a justification. Keep this list short: a bank name, a date, a code or a fixed sentence never belongs here.

allow.currency: policy-schema value of tools.create_promise.amount_unit (major units); generic vocabulary
allow.cents: policy-schema value of tools.create_promise.amount_unit (minor units); the kit docs ask for cents conversion
allow.human: canonical queue_map key in policy-schema.md (restructuring / human / support) and plain English in prose about transfers
allow.declined: plain English verb used to describe a refusal to answer security questions
